name: SuddenIncrease_OBS
description: Sudden increase using observed data only (lower bound).
epl: @Name('SuddenIncrease_OBS') select a, b from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated') -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated')] where b.value - a.value > 3 and b.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 2

name: SuddenIncrease_SYS
description: Sudden increase using observed + reconstructed data (system).
epl: @Name('SuddenIncrease_SYS') select a, b from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))] where b.value - a.value > 3 and b.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 2

name: SuddenIncrease_GT
description: Sudden increase using ground truth (upper bound).
epl: @Name('SuddenIncrease_GT') select a, b from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth')] where b.value - a.value > 3 and b.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 2

name: IncreasingTrend_OBS
description: Increasing trend using observed data only (lower bound).
epl: @Name('IncreasingTrend_OBS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated') -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated') -> c=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated')] where a.value < b.value and b.value < c.value and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 5

name: IncreasingTrend_SYS
description: Increasing trend using observed + reconstructed data (system).
epl: @Name('IncreasingTrend_SYS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> c=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))] where a.value < b.value and b.value < c.value and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 5

name: IncreasingTrend_GT
description: Increasing trend using ground truth (upper bound).
epl: @Name('IncreasingTrend_GT') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> c=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth')] where a.value < b.value and b.value < c.value and c.eventTs - a.eventTs <= 5

name: Flatline_OBS
description: Stable signal (flatline) using observed data only (lower bound).
epl: @Name('Flatline_OBS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated') -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated') -> c=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='validated')] where (a.value - b.value between -0.5 and 0.5) and (b.value - c.value between -0.5 and 0.5)

name: Flatline_SYS
description: Stable signal (flatline) using observed + reconstructed data (system).
epl: @Name('Flatline_SYS') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) -> c=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))] where (a.value - b.value between -0.5 and 0.5) and (b.value - c.value between -0.5 and 0.5)

name: Flatline_GT
description: Stable signal (flatline) using ground truth (upper bound).
epl: @Name('Flatline_GT') select a, b, c from pattern [every a=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> b=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') -> c=Event(src='signal-1', eventStatus='ground_truth')] where (a.value - b.value between -0.5 and 0.5) and (b.value - c.value between -0.5 and 0.5)
